verdict.rationale: Vue's own site claims a 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization.' That directly addresses relying on a compiler instead of hand-written diffing, but it is a single tagline with no detail on how templates are compiled into targeted DOM updates. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on compiler output and update-patching strategy, evidence of 'surgical' fine-grained DOM updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rendering efficiency.
